newsitem.title: USA: Data Documents CFO to retire.
newsitem.headline: Data Documents CFO to retire.

text.p: Data Documents Inc said Friday that Joseph Addison, 64, vice president and chief financial officer, will retire in the first quarter of 1997.
The company named A. Robert Thomas, 52, as senior vice president-finance.
When Addison retires, Thomas will be named chief financial officer, it said.
Thomas was also named to the newly created position of general manager of business forms, supplies and services.

Thomas previously served as chief operating officer with Oriental Trading Co Inc, an Omaha-based leader in the mail order industry. Previously, Thomas spent more than 20 years with Arthur Andersen and Co, providing consulting services to a variety of industries nationally and internationally.
